title: The Greylock: A Fairy Tale
author: Georg Ebers
description: "The Greylock: A Fairy Tale" by Georg Ebers is a fairy tale written in the late 19th century.
longDescription: The narrative follows the journey of a knight named Wendelin as he embarks on a quest filled with adventure, love, and transformation after rescuing a beautiful captive named Clementine from an evil spirit.

authorInfo.bio: Georg Ebers (1837–1898) wrote The Greylock: A Fairy Tale. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
